column2: memcg: split hugepage for memcg oom on cow
a new hugepage is allocated and charged to the memcg.  If the

column1: system is oom or the charge to the memcg fails
handler will return VM_FAULT_OOM which results in an oom kill.

column2: it's possible to fallback to splitting the hugepage so that the

column1: COW results only in an order-0 page being allocated and charged to the
memcg which has a higher liklihood to succeed.  This is expensive
because the hugepage must be split in the page fault handler
much better than unnecessarily oom killing a process.
